+SIDE = 0.227185

+TRAVEL_Z = 0.060

+DRAW_SPACING = 0.00080          # 0.8 mm target increments -> 8 mm/s
+
+
+def thin_zhang_suen(mask):
+    """Reduce a binary stroke mask to its one-pixel medial path."""
+    a = np.asarray(mask, dtype=bool).copy()
+    while True:
+        changed = False
+        for phase in (0, 1):
+            p = np.pad(a, 1)
+            n = [p[:-2, 1:-1], p[:-2, 2:], p[1:-1, 2:], p[2:, 2:],
+                 p[2:, 1:-1], p[2:, :-2], p[1:-1, :-2], p[:-2, :-2]]
+            count = sum(n)
+            transitions = sum((n[i] == 0) & (n[(i + 1) % 8] == 1) for i in range(8))
+            remove = a & (count >= 2) & (count <= 6) & (transitions == 1)
+            if phase == 0:
+                remove &= ~(n[0] & n[2] & n[4]) & ~(n[2] & n[4] & n[6])
+            else:
+                remove &= ~(n[0] & n[2] & n[6]) & ~(n[0] & n[4] & n[6])
+            if remove.any():
+                a[remove] = False
+                changed = True
+        if not changed:
+            return a
+
+
+def ordered_skeleton(mask, xoff, yoff):
+    """Return a correctly ordered open or closed skeleton path in image pixels."""
+    skel = thin_zhang_suen(mask)
+    ys, xs = np.where(skel)
+    pixels = {(int(x), int(y)) for y, x in zip(ys, xs)}
+    # Suppress a diagonal edge when an orthogonal bridge already connects it.
+    adj = {}
+    for x, y in pixels:
+        ns = []
+        for dy in (-1, 0, 1):
+            for dx in (-1, 0, 1):
+                if not (dx or dy):
+                    continue
+                q = (x + dx, y + dy)
+                if q not in pixels:
+                    continue
+                if dx and dy and ((x + dx, y) in pixels or (x, y + dy) in pixels):
+                    continue
+                ns.append(q)
+        adj[(x, y)] = ns
+    ends = [p for p, ns in adj.items() if len(ns) == 1]
+    closed = not ends
+    start = min(ends if ends else pixels, key=lambda p: (p[1], p[0]))
+    path = [start]
+    prev = None
+    cur = start
+    while True:
+        options = [p for p in adj[cur] if p != prev]
+        if not options:

+        nxt = options[0]
+        if closed and nxt == start:

+        if nxt in path:

+        path.append(nxt)
+        prev, cur = cur, nxt
+    xy = np.asarray(path, dtype=float)
+    xy[:, 0] += xoff
+    xy[:, 1] += yoff

+
+def smooth_path(points, closed, window=9):
+    if len(points) < window:
+        return points
+    half = window // 2
+    if closed:
+        ext = np.concatenate([points[-half:], points, points[:half]], axis=0)
+        sm = np.stack([np.convolve(ext[:, j], np.ones(window) / window, mode="valid")

+    sm = np.stack([np.convolve(ext[:, j], np.ones(window) / window, mode="valid")
+                   for j in range(2)], axis=1)
+    sm[0], sm[-1] = points[0], points[-1]
+    return sm
+
+
+def resample_image_path(points, closed, spacing_m=DRAW_SPACING):

+    else:
